items.name: Sea Oats Carolina Coast Printed Garment-Dyed Tee
items.alt: White tee printed on the chest with a lifelike painted clump of sea oats on a small dune, hanging from a driftwood pole in sunlit sand dunes with sea oats, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A relaxed garment-dyed tee printed with a lifelike painted clump of sea oats, the grass that holds the Carolina dunes together. Made to order.
facts: Relaxed fit, offered in sizes L to 3XL (S and M are not offered yet)
Heavyweight 6.1 oz ring-spun cotton, pre-shrunk, double-needle stitching, no side seams
Sea oats illustration printed on the front chest, not embroidered
